terminology.summary:
I unified the terminology and notation across the main paper (sections 00–11, A, G), the supplement (B1–B9, C–J), the three table generators and two figure scripts. The choices are recorded in /workspace/minlp-notes/paper-open-minlplib/development/terminology.md.

All 20 items of style-check-r1 group T are applied, plus the related J1, J2, J10, H2, L11 and H7, and numbers-check-r1 items 3, 14 and 15.

- **Tables:** regenerated from /tmp with `taskset -c 0,1`. make_tables.py passed 673 checks with 0 failed, make_points_table.py 88 and make_campaign_table.py 115. In numbers.json only text fields changed: labels, dates and one `second` field. No number field changed.
- **Figures:** fig-audit-margins and fig-camshape-deficit were regenerated, because their labels changed.
- **Build:** `make` exits 0. There are 0 LaTeX errors, 0 undefined or multiply defined references, 0 overfull boxes, no `??` in either PDF and no BibTeX warnings. The 14 TODO/DOI placeholders are unchanged.
- **Page counts:** main.pdf is 64 pages (was 63) and supplement.pdf is 136 (was 135). Most of the growth comes from the six-field certificate boxes in Section 5, the description list in Section 6 and wrapping word labels in the tables.

No certified number changed. Two displays were unified after checking them exactly against the sources:
- the camshape100 listed-dual gap is now 1.22e-6 everywhere (was 1.3e-6 in Sections 1.4 and 3.1 and S3.4). The exact gaps are 1.2157e-6 against the optimum and 1.2161e-6 against the listed point.
- the CAMINO margins in C6 are now 4.33%, 7.48% and 80.5% (were 4.3%, 7.4% and 80%), matching Section 8.2. The exact values are 4.335%, 7.487% and 80.598%, each rounded down.

Only targeted checks were run, all listed above. Nothing was committed, and nothing in research-20260929/ or literature/ was edited.
terminology.applied:
Letter codes replaced by word labels, each defined once in Section 2 or in a table caption:
- **Certificate classes:** A, A′, B–E became staged, comparison, dense rows, convexity, identity and reduced space. This covers the tab:closures and tab:structure captions, the Section 5 opening and Section 9.
- **Prior status:** F, f, Lst, T, K, U and N became fp closure, fp near-closure, listed solve, related model, value only, unread source and none. This covers tab:closures, Section 3.4 and S3.2 with tab:literature.
- **Evidence levels:** P, C and S became `\evid{hand}`, `\evid{stored}` and `\evid{rerun}`. This covers Section 2.5, every certificate box, tab:trust, Section 10 and the claim register.
- **Solved mark:** it is called "solved mark" throughout. Section 1.1 says once that the pages show it as S. Tables now use a check mark instead of a superscript S.
- **Point constructions:** (A)–(D) became a description list with names in Section 6.1 (H2), with matching labels in tab:points, tab:points-all and S2.
- **Audit proof methods:** routes A–D became listed-point check, Krawczyk proof, shifted Krawczyk proof and dedicated proof, in Section 7.3, tab:audit-pairs and S4.
- **Data readings:** types E, O, M and B became exact, outward, rounded and binary64 readings, in App. A.2, tab:trust and S7.
- **camshape checks:** (C1)–(C5) plus "c_H ≤ 2" became (K1)–(K6), in Section 5.1 and S1.3.

Words:
- **Solver names:** Gurobi everywhere, including table cells and the deficit figure legend. The generator maps MINLPLib's GUROBI label, and the tab:closures caption says so once.
- **KAN/ANN:** KAN is expanded at its first use in the body (Section 1.1) and in the S1.9 title. "ANN" is removed.
- **Instances vs models:** "instance" is used for MINLPLib entries (C4 heading, Sections 1–3, 5 and 8, Section 11, tab:campaign-runs, tab:claims-campaign, A, H, I). "Model" is kept for mathematical content.
- **"Open":** "open in sense (b)" became "open by our selection rule". The figure triangle is "hollow", the ann search has "pruned regions and unsplit leaf boxes", and the audit pairs are "not settled".
- **Smaller wording fixes:**
  - "tolerance-level closure" in the abstract and C7;
  - "listing dual" became "dual bound in the instance list" in the main text and "instance-list dual" in S1.1 and S3.4;
  - "OSIL" instead of "OSiL" (the schema footnote keeps OSiL);
  - "proved valid" instead of "proven valid";
  - "certificate family (a row of Table 1)";
  - tab:trust wording "separately written code";
  - all full dates in ISO form, including the audit table, B1, B6, H and D;
  - host memory 47 GiB in S6.
- **Split terminology:** Section 4.1 now states once how splits relate to Krotov's verification functions and to discrete calibrations. The optcdeg2 split is written φ_{t−1} acting on the state (y_t, v_t), consistent with the index convention of Section 4.1, in Section 4.3 and S1.2. "Calibration arrays" became "split data". The S1.4 chain remark points to Section 4.1.
- **Certificate boxes:** all five boxes in Section 5 now use the six fields Inputs, Computation, Data reading, Implementations, Evidence level and Replay. The ex6_2 and pricing050 box gives the level and replay time per instance (H7).

Notation:
- **KAN optimum:** v*(𝓡) ≤ v*(𝓡_P) everywhere (Sections 1, 3 and 5.5, tab:kan, S1.9, S6).
- **Feasible set:** \feas in tab:claims.
- **KAN relaxation:** \Rnet in tab:solvers (numbers-check item 14).
- **dtoc5 dual function:** q(λ) (Section 4.2, S1.2, tab:trust, register).
- **Audit display value and upper end:** d = d(s) and φ (Sections 1 and 7, tab:audit-pairs, S4, the audit figure).
- **Krawczyk map:** G, with the interval vector **v** and the fixed-point map T (Theorem 6.1, S2, S4).
- **pindyck price set:** P (Section 5.3, S1.5).
- **powerflow buses:** bus numbers 30 and 2 as indices (Section 5.3, S1.6).
- **Pump speed bound:** ℓ (Section 8, S6).
- **waterno2 horizon constant:** r_T (Section 4.5, S1.8; integration-notes item 8).
- **App. B shortest-path distance:** dist_t(D).
- **Local symbol in the S1.4 chain proof:** Ξ, because 𝓡 is reserved for the KAN relaxation.

Data fix: the second implementation for sssd20-04persp is now recorded as "Krawczyk, exact", matching tab:audit-second and dossiers/audit.md (numbers-check item 3).

Other files touched: macros.tex (comment), development/labels.md (box template and evidence levels), and the generators make_tables.py, make_points_table.py, make_campaign_table.py, make_fig_audit.py and make_fig_deficit.py. Column widths in tab:closures, tab:trust, tab:structure, tab:points-all, tab:staged, tab:literature and tab:audit-pairs were adjusted so the word labels fit without overfull boxes.

fixes.rejected:
- **L4, exact replacement wording (adjusted, not rejected):** I deleted [L] but wrote "No displayed result assumes an error bound for a floating-point library function." The suggested "no result rests on a hypothesis about the accuracy of a library function" would be false, because T-mp trusts mpmath, which is a library. I checked the KAN (rigorous-exp rerun), ann and eg (audited run) cases: none assumes such an error bound.
- **B7, renaming in the supplement and Section 5:** not done. "Authors' code" and "verifier's code" are used throughout B0–B5, and B0-families.tex:9 points to Section 2.6 for their definition. Section 2.6 now defines first/second implementation and maps the old names to them. The Section 5 box (05-other.tex:266) is another editor's file.
- **L2, "the second certifies only a slightly weaker bound" (reworded, not rejected):** under the new first/second definition this would be wrong. For lukvle10, catmix, etamac and pindyck the weaker bound comes from the authors' (first) code. The text now says "the displayed dual bound comes from one of them and the other certifies only a slightly weaker bound". I also wrote "computer-assisted dual certificate", because the hvycrash dual is a proof by hand.
- **numbers-check 17, option to add ex6_2_7:** rejected in favour of "for example". No source evaluates that point's objective, so "below our dual by rounding alone" cannot be asserted for it.
- **L18, the parenthetical "(1.68% for the smallest instance)":** dropped to keep the abstract within 250 words. "At most 10.82%" is exact.
- **R7, reduce the eg trust statement to one sentence:** kept as two shorter sentences. Decision 7 requires the stated trust base: H0, the checking programs, the recorded audited run, and no accuracy assumption on the exponential and power routines of NumPy, libm and SVML.
- **Moving Section 2.4 (display rules) to Appendix A:** not done. Appendix A is itself over its 3-page target, so the move would only shift the excess.
- **R8 citation reduction in Section 1.4:** not needed. Section 1.4 already names mechanism families only and has no result-by-result mapping (that is in Section 4.1). The verbatim duplicate is 06:19, in another file. S11's split is applied.
